Ref. No............... Date:.................
INTERVIEW NOTIFICATION
Senapati, 8th October, 2026
With reference to the notification No.EMRS/Oinam/ dated 10th
Sept, 2026 for the engagement of Teaching and Non- Teaching
staff for the academic session 2026-2027 of Eklavya Model
Residential School (EMRS) Oinam. It is hereby notified to all
eligible candidates who have submitted their application forms at
SDO Purul Office, DC Complex, Senapati that the interview will
be held as per the schedule below:
DATE OF INTERVIEW:
13th October, 2026 : Physical Science, Social Science, Fine Art
14th October, 2026: English, Mathematics, Hindi, Physical
Education, Fine Art, Accountant, Mess Helper, Cook
15th October, 2026: Staff Nurse, Warden (male & female), Junior
Secretariat Assistant, Sweeper, Security/ Chowkidar
VENUE : SDO PURUL OFFICE, DC COMPLEX, SENAPATI
TIME : 10:00 AM
Instructions:
1. Candidates must bring all the original certificates and
experience certificate and identity proof at the time of interview.
2. Final eligibility and remuneration will be as per the latest
NESTS guidelines and approval of the competent authority/
DLMC.
Sd/-
Tomuishang Wairok Maring
I/C Principal EMRS Oinam
(Under NESTS, Ministry of Tribal Affairs Govt.of India)
